evidence.name: Screen field: What kind of value it stores
evidence.userNeed: Know what "What kind of value it stores" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: What kind of value it stores
sections.description: Sets the kind of value this variable holds, which must fit the screen. Use Choice for single-select screens, Multiple choices for multi-select lists or grids where visitors pick several, Number for numeric input like age or weight, and Text for free-form typed answers. The screen only offers compatible types, and the Choice options you can branch and report on are defined below.
